mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and renal tubular damage, which impairs bumetanide clearance and increases risk of electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia); both drugs promote renal potassium and magnesium wasting.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium), and fluid status closely; consider potassium and magnesium supplementation; use lowest effective bumetanide dose; evaluate necessity of concurrent use.
